gate_policy: No final acceptance or best-architecture claim while any required stage is not PASS

slam_pose_graph.evidence: Independent ORB + RGB-D PnP 596 frames, 9 verified nonlocal constraints; optimized SE3 pose-graph ATE RMSE 0.05498m, RPE@30 0.04777m on TUM fr1_desk. Custom VO, not RTAB-Map.
slam_pose_graph.not_yet: Multi-sequence accuracy and physical robot localization

tsdf_reconstruction.evidence: Dense 596-frame 3cm TSDF: 49,442 vertices, 90,058 faces and 48,490 surface points, colored 15mm object point map; independent scanned GT surface proximity measured on annotated RGBD-Scenes v2 scene11/14, but scene14/11 used dataset camera poses.

occupancy_navigation_ready.evidence: No calibrated floor and Nav2 collision test

object_reidentification_gt.evidence: ObjectMemoryV2 static 3D risk-aware gallery and review queue implemented. On frozen YOLOE26 detections, development ai_002_001 target IDF1 0.30928 -> 0.32692 and ai_005_001 0.02592 -> 0.04769 (0 false merges), BUT independent unseen ai_017_001 decreased 0.35178 -> 0.34749; on unseen oracle masks decreased 0.95527 -> 0.94236 although false merges fell 1 -> 0. Physical ID robustness NOT ACCEPTED. YOLOE26x factorial Hypersim 20frame scene ai_002_001 IDF1=0.399, ai_005_001=0.192; GT-oracle masks 0.896 and 0.998; classifier/mask/recall breakdown measured, not deployable. CI 40769982699.
object_reidentification_gt.limits: Hypersim photo-real synthetic, GT world 3D coordinates; 19 RGB-D frames per scene, YOLOE26 mask quality remains dominant bottleneck. Does not evaluate SLAM or on-robot.

full_sequences_2026_10_29.warning: Observational GT evaluation only, GT world XYZ used, no SLAM, not official MOT IDF1. Full 100frames each of 3 selected Hypersim scenes, NOT entire dataset.

object_reidentification_gt.full_300_frame_root_cause: 6,612 target GT object occurrences, only 1,553 with YOLOE26x IoU>=0.10 matched masks. In V2 270 GT-object UUID transitions: 122 consecutive visible, 53 visible detector missed, 29 visible but intermediate NULL UUID, 66 true FOV re-entry. 76 transitions create genuinely new SQLite UUID; 194 select preexisting UUID. Pre-frame gate: 125 class flip, 127 static class-specific 3D radius, 18 other. Full 7-condition counterfactual IDF1: raw pooled 0.21613, oracle class 0.24166, oracle GT mask 3D geometry 0.29465, GT add missed 0.85281, GT-only 0.95821. Stable physical IDs FAIL. Short TemporalTracker not used in these Hypersim evaluations.

loop_closure_object_reprojection.evidence: ObjectMemoryV2.correct_pose_graph atomically reprojects every original RGB-D camera-frame observation, preserves UUIDs, fails closed on missing poses; marks NEEDS_REASSOCIATION. Separate persistent object-surface voxel layer is NOT automatically rebuilt after pose graph correction, nor have loop-closure pose sequences been validated end-to-end.

semantic_vlm.evidence: SmolVLM-256M-Instruct real inference: 24 confirmed candidate objects, up to two images per object; 12 descriptions lexically consistent and persisted, 12 quarantined, zero physical-ID changes. No GT semantic accuracy.

nav2_integration.evidence: Actual ROS2 Jazzy nav2_planner ComputePathToPose succeeded (status=4) with 30 poses for object UUID target on reconstructed gravity-aligned TUM occupancy; no robot control/localization and no NavigateToPose.
